description_en: Retrieves live recording information. You can call this operation to obtain the playback URL after a live stream ends. If the live stream has not ended, the result is empty
description_zh: 调用GetLiveRecord获取直播录制信息。可用于直播结束后获取回放地址，如果直播未结束，结果为空
kebab_example: aliyun imp get-live-record --app-id lq0000cu --live-id AE350000T95F --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetLiveRecord

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the application, which is a 6-character string of lowercase letters and digits. You can obtain this identifier from the console after creating the application
parameters.help_zh: 应用唯一标识，由6位小写字母、数字组成，由控制台创建后获取
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the live stream, returned by calling CreateLiveRoom
parameters.help_zh: 直播唯一标识，由调用CreateLiveRoom返回
parameters.name: live_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the operator
parameters.name: user_id

Result.description_en: The response struct of the API request
Result.description_zh: API请求的返回结果结构体

PlaybackUrlMap.description_en: The collection of playback URLs. The key indicates the playback video type. Valid values: m3u8, mp4, and flv. Currently, only the m3u8 type is provided
PlaybackUrlMap.description_zh: 回放地址集合。key值代表回放视频类型，取值m3u8, mp4, flv，当前仅提供m3u8类型

Result.title_en: API请求的返回结果结构体。
Result.title_zh: API请求的返回结果结构体。
